scope: Conditional follow-up only for interventions passing both seeds in the predeclared screen. Every supported arm and matched A is evaluated for both seeds.
population: Original Raw-locked top30 pairs per each of four sequences; no frame reselection.
point_readout: Unchanged deterministic ACM-inflection-LSC helper and per-measurement curvature reset; no historical independent-step bootstrap claim.
readiness_guard: No increase in any of four per-sequence step-SD point estimates or median cross-axis magnitude vs matching A, except 1e-6 nm numerical tolerance. Differences are not statistical significance. All 120 pairs and all expected centers must exist.
training: No automatic long training or deployment.
